self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Echoing Ballad (R1): hits have a 60% chance to inflict a small AoE attack dealing 125% Physical ATK DMG (once every 4s). Modeled as a supplementary hit at the full proc value on any attack (scales with ATK and CRIT only — no DMG% bonuses). The flat CRIT DMG +20% part is modeled separately as an unconditional self modifier.
